page_title: ATM 1-0 OSA | Atletico Madrid v Osasuna 12/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Referee Isidro Diaz halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Diego Simeone, then shows him a yellow.
90+1' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) tries to score from mid-range after collecting a rebound, but his shot lacks accuracy and sails high over the bar.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' Vicente Moreno appears to have said too much and referee Isidro Diaz comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
85' Vicente Moreno has decided to make a change. Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) replaces Ruben Garcia.
84' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) works the corner short.
83' The shots on goal statistics – 4:1.
78' The game has come to an end for Julian Alvarez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid).
78' Vicente Moreno decides to make a substitution. Raul Garcia will be replaced by Ante Budimir (Osasuna).
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Giuliano Simeone leaves the pitch and Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) comes on.
71' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atl. Madrid.

71' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net. The referee signals a corner kick to Atl. Madrid.
70' Good clearance! Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him.
63' Vicente Moreno has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jesus Areso (Osasuna) replacing Lucas Torro.
63' Flavien Boyomo will be replaced by Aimar Oroz (Osasuna).
63' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ruben Pena.
58' Osasuna couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Jan Oblak (Atl. Madrid) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
58' Dangerous play by Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid). Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul.
55' 1 - 0 Goal! Clement Lenglet provides Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) with a nice pass inside the box. It allows him to finish with a strike into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
55' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
53' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
53' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
52' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
50' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

49' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
47' The attendance is 64801.
46' Diego Simeone has made a change at the break. Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) has come on in place of Conor Gallagher.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' Isidro Diaz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
38' An attempted cross from Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
37' Half-chance! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) plays a pass into the box, but Sergio Herrera reacts well to snuff out the attack.
35' The free kick is taken by Ruben Garcia (Osasuna), but ball is cleared.
34' It must be a yellow card. It is. Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
34' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) tackles a bit over-zealously and Isidro Diaz blows for a foul.
33' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
31' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.

28' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball down to the middle of the goal. Sergio Herrera shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
25' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle and it's Lucas Torro (Osasuna) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
25' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
24' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) latches on to a sweet cross into the box and misses with a header way wide of the left post.
23' The players claim that Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) handled the ball inside the box and it seems they are right.
22' 66:34 – the ratio of ball possession.
13' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low drive towards the middle of the net, but Sergio Herrera is alert and denies him.
9' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Atl. Madrid due to a handball in the build-up play.
9' The Atl. Madrid players halt their celebrations as referee Isidro Diaz makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.

7' Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) meets a perfect cross from Nahuel Molina deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike inside the right post. The score is 1:0.

6' Atl. Madrid slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

5' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Isidro Diaz with no other option than to blow for a foul.
4' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Atl. Madrid will kick the game off.
Isidro Diaz will officiate today.
